title: Calibrating Doubt, Inference and Certainty
goal: Distinguish certainty and deduction from doubt and ambiguity using indicative vs subjunctive after doubt and inference verbs.
grammar: indicative vs subjunctive with doubt, certainty and inference verbs

items: I can use the subjunctive after *dudo que*, *no creo que*, *no es seguro que* and *no está claro que*.
I can keep the indicative after affirmative inference verbs (*sospechar*, *deducir*, *inferir*) and negated *no dudo que*.
I can discuss ambiguity, suspicion, deduction, inference and presuppositions.
